faqs.question: What is ChatSuite AI?
faqs.answer: ChatSuite AI is a premier white-label AI chatbot platform that allows businesses to build, customize, and embed custom AI virtual assistants on their websites. It captures leads, resolves support inquiries using FAQs, and displays deep performance analytics.

faqs.question: How do I embed the chatbot on my website?
faqs.answer: Embedding is incredibly easy! Once you customize your chatbot in the dashboard, copy the 1-line script tag generated under the "Settings" tab and paste it before the closing </body> tag of your website.

faqs.question: What are the pricing tiers?
faqs.answer: We offer three tiers: Starter ($29/mo for 1 chatbot, 2,000 messages/mo), Professional ($79/mo for 3 chatbots, 10,000 messages/mo, custom branding), and Enterprise ($249/mo for unlimited chatbots, unlimited messages, full API key access, and multi-language support).

faqs.question: Can I white-label the dashboard and widget?
faqs.answer: Yes! The Professional and Enterprise plans allow complete white-labeling, letting you change the bot name, avatar logo, welcome text, primary colors, and fully strip out the "Powered by" branding.

faqs.question: Does the chatbot support image and PDF uploads?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Users can upload images (the chatbot will understand what is in them) and PDFs (the chatbot will automatically parse the document text on the fly to answer complex document queries).

def calculate_factorial(n):
    """
    Calculate the factorial of a given number.

    Args:
        n (int): The number to calculate the factorial for.

    Returns:
        int: The factorial of the given number.
    """
    if n == 0:
        return 1
    else:
        return n * calculate_factorial(n-1)

def calculate_factorial_iterative(n):
    result = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        result *= i
    return result
